sources.title: Transparent glossary arithmetic and stated course conventions
sources.details: ID assignments are explicit assumptions: 狗=0/看=1/貓=2 so 貓看狗=[2,1,0]; ID2 lookup returns [0.2,-0.1]. 2 rows x3 columns -> shape[2,3]. 8 bits -> 2^8=256 values 0..255. softmax([2,1,0])=exp(z)/sum exp(z), third-class CE=-log p3. For T>0, scaling and exponentiation preserve within-row argmax, but max softmax across rows depends on all logit gaps. KL(p||p)=sum p*0=0, H([.5,.5])=ln2. SNR=10log10(sum x²/sum(x-y)²), tested on [1,-1] vs [.9,-.9] ->20dB. 440Hz is cycles/sec by definition. Jev Choice concentration n=3,pmax=.6 gives (.6-1/3)/(1-1/3)=.4. Finite accepted-risk denominator is accepts; coverage denominator is all preplanned items. An empty accept set has undefined conditional risk. These are mechanism/definition checks, not model quality evidence.
